primary_task: Debug and QA a local web or Electron app through a persistent Playwright session driven from a js_repl tool, with functional and visual checks and screenshots.

requirements.name: js_repl
requirements.evidence: "`js_repl` must be enabled for this skill."; "If `js_repl` is missing, enable it in `~/.codex/config.toml`"
requirements.basis: The tools list has bash, read, write, edit, web_fetch, web_search, ask_user, agent, skill, tasks, ... and no js_repl; lacks: connectors or integrations other than the tools listed

requirements.name: codex.emitImage
requirements.basis: The tools list has no codex.emitImage; files can only be sent with send_user_file

requirements.name: playwright (npm)
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, ...)

requirements.name: Chromium browser binary (headed, headless:false)
requirements.basis: The manifest does not say; the Playwright browser download host is not on the allow-list ('other hosts are refused') and a display for headed mode is not stated. I would need to check whether a browser is preinstalled.

requirements.name: sandbox disabled (--sandbox danger-full-access)
requirements.evidence: "run this workflow with sandboxing disabled: start Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access`"
requirements.basis: The manifest says nothing about sandbox mode; this is a Codex setting.

requirements.name: display / native window for Electron or headed mode
requirements.basis: The manifest states no GPU or devices but does not mention a display server.

notes: The whole workflow is expressed as js_repl cells and Codex session flags, which this runtime lacks. A rewrite using the node CLI with Playwright scripts would be a different document; under that hypothetical reading the verdict would depend on the Chromium download, which is unknown.
